in_marathi.name: Ganeshkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of new beginnings, wisdom, and power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganeshkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ganesh is the god of new beginnings and wisdom. Kumar refers to young and vigorous. The name Ganeshkumar signifies the youthful and powerful embodiment of Ganesha, the remover of obstacles.
